factual_error: original human criterion and factual-error evidence
paper: Kim et al., What Hallucinations Have We Measured? Semantic Illusion, Confabulation, and Expressed Uncertainty, arXiv:2610.38520v2 (2026-11-11)

expressed_uncertainty.original_criterion: Explicit human annotation of expressed uncertainty distinct from missingness
expressed_uncertainty.qualifies: requires dedicated human uncertainty label; -1 sentinel conflates missing/uncertain or not annotated

factual_error.qualifies: binary factual-error target when authenticated annotator1_label is in {0, 1}

reelicitation.original_criterion: Same-generator semantically equivalent prompt re-elicitations with human factuality labels
reelicitation.qualifies: requires >=2 equivalent prompts per (qid, generator) with human verification to separate SI from CF
